name: Ushidera Mikoto
source:
Name: Mikoto Ushidera
Sex: Male
Age: 42 (Past) | 48 (Present)
Birthday: January 4
Profession: Police HQ Detective
Likes: Caramel, Chocolate, Biscuits, Ice Cream
Dislikes: Threats, Foxes
Hobbies: Mobile Games
Skills: Can Use Cling Wrap Without Messing It Up

[Past]
A detective from Police HQ investigating the murders. Having found multiple culprits of cold cases in the past, he is known as... The Melter.
[Present]
Police HQ Special Investigations Detective. His department specializes in cold cases. 6 years ago, Ushidera was in a different department, but since the HB case was unsolved, he moved. 

[From the in-game character descriptions]
